page_title: MET 0-0 LIL | Metz v Lille 06/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Gaetan Perrin (Lille) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90+4' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

90+3' Metz slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Georgiy Tsitaishvili comes off the pitch to be replaced by Giorgi Kvilitaia (Metz).
88' Soriba Diaoune (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

87' The ball rebounds out to Felix Correia (Lille) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
85' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
82' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Tiago Santos is replaced by Ngalayel Mukau (Lille).
82' It's time for a substitution. Calvin Verdonk (Lille) comes on in place of Romain Perraud.
80' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Gaetan Perrin (Lille). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
80' The corner kick from Benjamin Andre (Lille) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. Lille have been awarded a corner kick.

78' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Metz are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
76' Tiago Santos (Lille) hides his face in shame! He blows a big chance to score from the rebound and sees his shot smash against the right post!
75' Lille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
73' Guillaume Paradis shows a yellow card to Koffi Kouao (Metz) for his blatant foul.
71' Substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson did his best and is replaced by Gaetan Perrin (Lille).
71' Here is a change. Olivier Giroud is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Soriba Diaoune (Lille).
70' The substitution is prepared. Believe Munongo (Metz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Benjamin Stambouli.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jessy Deminguet leaves the pitch and Gauthier Hein (Metz) comes on.
69' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Berke Ozer earns his money with a fine reflex save.
67' Habib Diallo (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.

65' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The ball is out of play. Metz will have a chance to score from a corner.
63' Lille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
62' Substitution. Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) on for Lucas Michal.
61' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Noah Edjouma and he is replaced by Felix Correia (Lille).

59' The opposition back off Olivier Giroud (Lille) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.

58' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
57' Alpha Toure (Metz) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

55' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.

51' A long ball forward to Olivier Giroud (Lille) is intercepted.

50' Lucas Michal (Metz) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
50' Metz showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is out of play. Lille will take a throw-in.
48' Wonderful movement by Lille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
47' The game is interrupted now, Olivier Giroud (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+3' Alpha Toure (Metz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Metz show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
43' Berke Ozer displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Habib Diallo (Metz) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

41' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz. That was close by Noah Edjouma (Lille)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
40' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.

37' Metz are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

32' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) brings an opponent down and Guillaume Paradis interrupts the game.
31' Olivier Giroud (Lille) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
29' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) picks up an injury.
28' Lille decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.

23' Lille take a short corner kick.
23' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lille.
23' The referee blows his whistle as Romain Perraud (Lille) was too aggressive in his challenge.
21' Wonderful movement by Lille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
20' The goal by Metz won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
20' The Metz players halt their celebrations as referee Guillaume Paradis makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
18' Alpha Toure (Metz) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
15' Metz showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lille.
14' Romain Perraud (Lille) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Guillaume Paradis signals.
13' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jonathan Fischer comes off the line to clear the ball away.
10' Lille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
8' Romain Perraud (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Metz are taking a throw-in.
7' The yellow card goes to Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille).
7' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Guillaume Paradis changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
6' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Lille as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
5' Jonathan Fischer (Metz) brings his opponent down. Guillaume Paradis has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Lille! Great chance to score.
4' Metz are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
3' The game is interrupted. Jessy Deminguet (Metz) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
